text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh,
I really thought I'd catch something here though~...
Whoops, looks like someone beat me to it~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, hello there.
Are you out fishing too, Sky-san?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, just catching my breath~
Mind if I take the spot next to you~?♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Alright, that's one down!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hup! And that's another one!
Ooh, they're biting on the rig too~♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa...
And I couldn't catch a single thing...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I used to be pretty confident in my fishin' too, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Have you been fishing for quite a long time?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ever since I was little,
I used to go into rivers to catch fish and crayfish!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You curl your hand like this and wedge it between your fingers—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be that catchin' 'em
with bare hands is easier than with a rod...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, catching them barehanded sounds pretty intriguing~
Hey, hey, show me how you do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's a bit embarrassin', but
alright! Take a good look!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What do you think! We caught quite a lot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
More than just 'a few'...
you've caught over ten of them, haven't you...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I remembered the trick!
It's that feeling of surging forward with everything I've got, no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I've felt this way...
Having fun, totally swept up in it...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're surprisingly wild, aren't you...

From this day on, whether she remembered a knack for it or not,
Yukino Bijin's running became noticeably sharper.
